summary: Gentle reactivation after newborn arrival — rebuild the habit with short sessions, no running yet, all riding in Z2 and shoulder-safe strength

sessions.name: Easy Spin: Re-ignition
sessions.focus: Restart aerobic engine at low cost, pure Z2 stimulus

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, let legs settle, no HR pressure
Z2 aerobic, 85-90 rpm, conversational effort, HR 146-155 bpm target
Easy spin, let HR drop below 130 bpm before stopping

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core (Shoulder-Safe)
sessions.focus: Re-engage legs, glutes, and core without loading the shoulder
sessions.notes: 2 rounds: 10x goblet squat 16kg, 10x RDL 22kg, 8x TRX split squat per leg (balance only — no shoulder load; swap to reverse lunge with 11kg dumbbell at side if any shoulder discomfort), 15x banded glute bridge, 6x dead bug per side, 30s plank. 60s rest between exercises, 90s between rounds. Shoulder: no pressing or pulling movements.

steps.description: Leg swings front/back and lateral (10 each leg), hip circles, 10 bodyweight squats, 10 glute bridges
Goblet Squat 10x 16kg → RDL 10x 22kg → TRX Split Squat 8x/leg → Banded Glute Bridge 15x → Dead Bug 6x/side → Plank 30s. 60s rest between exercises.
90s rest between rounds, shake out legs, controlled breathing
Hip flexor stretch 60s/side, hamstring stretch 45s/side, glute figure-4 stretch 45s/side

sessions.name: Easy Spin: Aerobic Flush
sessions.focus: Low-intensity aerobic stimulus, flush Wednesday leg fatigue

steps.description: Z1 easy cadence, no pressure, let the legs loosen up
Soft Z2, 85-90 rpm, HR 146-158 bpm. If HR elevated above 158 at this power, drop to 95W — sleep debt is real, back off without guilt
Easy spin to HR below 120 bpm

sessions.name: Aerobic Builder: Z2 Endurance Ride
sessions.focus: Longest aerobic session of the week — base durability and fat oxidation

steps.description: Progressive build: start 90W, add ~5W every 2 min, arrive at 115W by minute 8. Let body ease in.
First 15 min Z2 lower band, 87-92 rpm, HR 146-155 bpm. Settle into rhythm, do not push yet.
Final 20 min Z2 upper band, 87-92 rpm, HR 155-162 bpm. Only push here if HR is stable and effort feels genuinely sustainable. Back off if HR exceeds 162 bpm.
5 min at 90-100W, then drop to below 85W for final 7 min. HR below 125 bpm before stopping.
